Definition: from G575 and G2928; to conceal away (i.e. fully); figuratively, to keep secret:--hide.
BiblicalUsage: To conceal away, to keep secret. Paul speaks the wisdom of God in a mystery, even the hidden wisdom ordained before the world unto our glory, in 1 Corinthians 2:7 — a mystery hid from ages and generations but now made manifest to His saints, in Colossians 1:26, and hid in God from the beginning of the world, in Ephesians 3:9. Jesus thanks the Father in Luke 10:21 for hiding these things from the wise and prudent and revealing them unto babes.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God's hiding is not His refusal but His timing. The mystery was hidden for ages so that, when it was made manifest, the whole world would see it was His doing and not man's discovery. And He still hides it from the wise who trust their own wisdom — the cover comes off only for those willing to receive it like children.
